accepted: The MP4 fragment-index seek branch keeps its resolved decode start while retaining the requested accurate display cutoff. This removes the previously corrupt picture and accumulated clock drift.
Selected subtitle tracks can require a packet in an earlier video fragment. The branch includes that fragment and starts audio/video at its indexed decode point so a covering long cue is restored.

Each applies/reset delays, preserves the held frame, resumes, stops/releases normally and has no late-picture warning.
